thread:
maya: Heads up — oat milk is down to 1 carton in the fridge :cry: and the sparkling shelf only has a few cans left. Anyone want to deputize a snack/coffee run?

sam: guilty, I finished a 12-pack yesterday. My bad. I can swing by in the afternoon if someone covers *scones*. :sweat_smile:

devon: I’m on call this afternoon, so can't leave. If someone does a run, pls get seltzer (no lime) and poppyseed scones if available.

cleo: I can go in 20 if that's helpful. What else besides seltzer + scones?

maya: jam is out (blueberry jam 0 jars). Also low on oat milk and single-use wooden stirrers.

ravi: vote: poppyseed scones > chocolate croissants. but will accept croissants in emergencies. :yum:

cleo: ok grabbing: ```- 2 cartons oat milk
- 12 cans plain seltzer
- 6 poppyseed scones (or 6 assorted pastries)
- 1 jar blueberry jam
- stirrers``` I'll try to get oatmilk that isn't the tiny shelf-stable cartons.

sam: amazing, thank you cleo! I'll Venmo for my share — tag me with the total.

maya: note: someone left almond milk unlabeled. if you grabbed it, pls move to personal bin. we have allergies in the office, so don't replace oat with almond without asking.

kitchen-bot: Inventory alert: oat_milk=1, seltzer_cans=3, blueberry_jam=0, stirrers=2. Auto-reminder will ping ops when oat_milk<=1.

cleo: Quick Q on receipts — do we keep them in the kitchen folder or just post photo here?

ravi: photo here is fine, put total + who owes what. i'll calculate.

sam: also — 2 people want decaf? quick strawpoll: decaf? yes/no

maya: no decaf this round. next time maybe.

cleo: heading out now, will post receipt pic in ~30. back in 35. :running_shoe:

devon: thank you!! truly the real MVPs for saving my meeting-laden afternoon. :pray:

maya: fridge note: can we put a sticky that says "Label personal dairy"? small sign + Sharpie = office bliss.

cleo: added to my list. stickies + marker on the run.

sam: receipt posted: https://imgur.com/example_receipt (total $28.40). cleo pls confirm and i'll send $14.20.

cleo: confirmed, I grabbed oat milk brand 'CloudFarm' (2L cartons). sending Venmo request now.

ravi: split and paid. thanks everyone. enjoy scones. :tada:

maya: victory pastry photos or it didn't happen. pls drop pics when warm. :camera_with_flash:
